title: Sudden mastery of Morse code under threat of being sent to Vietnam
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Sudden mastery of Morse code under threat of being sent to Vietnam, about 1960s at Army intelligence school (location not named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Vietnam so I passed 10 12 15 20 uh 15 18 22 that day in like two hours something popped in my head

plain: A former US Army intelligence soldier named Joe McMoneagle says that in the 1960s, while training at an Army intelligence school, he was told he would be sent to the Vietnam War if he failed his Morse code tests. He says that in about two hours on one day he passed test after test at faster and faster speeds, because something just "popped" in his head. He tells it as an early sign of unusual mental abilities.
